sentences.text: For a business-purpose loan to an MSE, the in-force UCB direction says a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh. [E13, E15]
The same in-force direction says that, in cases other than those covered by paragraph 261(1) and 261(2), any pre-payment charges shall be as per the approved policy of the UCB. [E16]
The older RBI directions that covered business-purpose loans to individuals and MSEs were superseded or repealed and are no longer in force on the as-of date. [R1, R2, E10, E13]

The statement that RBI requires UCBs to charge at least 2% on pre-payment of MSE loans is not supported by the in-force directions cited here, because the relevant in-force text includes a no-charge rule for a Tier 3 UCB up to ₹50 lakh. [E15, E16]

missing.searched: Needed to determine whether the loan falls within the up-to-₹50 lakh no-charge rule in paragraph 261(2)(ii).
Needed only if applying the sanction-date-based scope of the UCB directions.
